# NOTE: This CMakeLists.txt has NOT been build-verified on this machine.
# There is no native Linux compiler / pkg-config / gtk+-3.0 dev headers
# available in this environment, and `flutter create --platforms=linux`
# refuses to scaffold a native template here. It closely mirrors the
# standard CMakeLists.txt generated by
# `flutter create --template=plugin --platforms=linux` for a federated
# Linux (GTK) plugin, plus a `pkg_check_modules` block for GStreamer (the
# documented way plugins that use GStreamer, e.g. `video_player_linux`-style
# community plugins, add it), and needs a real Linux build (local machine
# or CI) to confirm it actually configures/compiles.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
set(PROJECT_NAME "attachment_engine_linux")
project(${PROJECT_NAME} LANGUAGES CXX C)

set(PLUGIN_NAME "attachment_engine_linux_plugin")

# No share_channel.cc: Share has no native implementation on Linux (see
# share_channel.h) so there is nothing to compile for it.
add_library(${PLUGIN_NAME} SHARED
  "attachment_engine_linux_plugin.cc"
  "audio_channel.cc"
  "video_channel.cc"
)

apply_standard_settings(${PLUGIN_NAME})
set_target_properties(${PLUGIN_NAME} PROPERTIES CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
target_compile_definitions(${PLUGIN_NAME} PRIVATE FLUTTER_PLUGIN_IMPL)
target_include_directories(${PLUGIN_NAME} INTERFACE
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(GTK REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET gtk+-3.0)

# GStreamer playbin (audio/video playback) + gtksink (video embedding) —
# https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/documentation/tutorials/basic/playbin-usage.html
# https://gstreamer.freedesktop.org/documentation/gtk/index.html (gtksink)
pkg_check_modules(GSTREAMER REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET
  gstreamer-1.0
  gstreamer-video-1.0
)

target_link_libraries(${PLUGIN_NAME} PRIVATE flutter)
target_link_libraries(${PLUGIN_NAME} PRIVATE PkgConfig::GTK)
target_link_libraries(${PLUGIN_NAME} PRIVATE PkgConfig::GSTREAMER)

# List of absolute paths to libraries that should be bundled with the
# plugin.
set(attachment_engine_linux_bundled_libraries
  ""
  PARENT_SCOPE
)
